name: relax every edge repeatedly
mechanism: start with infinite costs except the source and repeat, once per vertex, a pass that lowers each edge's head cost to the tail cost plus the edge weight when that is smaller; a change on the final pass reveals a negative cycle

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Bellman–Ford algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Routing for graphs: computes shortest paths in a weighted graph (where some of the edge weights may be negative)

fails_when: quadratic-ish; early exit when a pass changes nothing
